$comment: SSOT for AGENTS.md's Paste Intake table (AGENTS.md#Paste Intake, ~line 447). Every `routes[]` entry's whatTheyPasted/routeTo/capturesInto fields must be the VERBATIM text of that table's corresponding row (same order) — tests/paste-intake-parity.test.mjs parses AGENTS.md's actual markdown table and fails if this file drifts from it. Do not hand-edit these three fields without updating AGENTS.md's table (or vice versa) in the same change. `m9` fields are this file's own addition (not present in AGENTS.md) — the parity test never checks them; they drive config/intake-classify.schema.json's kind enum and src/core/intake/dispatch.mjs's lane table for the M9 milestone. `m9.status: "deferred"` means the row's owning skill has no dispatch lane wired up yet (WebSearch/session-browser tooling mismatch in the headless intake pipeline — tracked in the private roadmap, not a silent gap).

routes.capturesInto: full JD body saved to `workspace/jobs/<…>.md` + mirrored to `artifacts.jd`, the application row

routes.whatTheyPasted: "I withdrew from X" / "I pulled out" / "withdraw my application" / candidate-initiated exit
routes.capturesInto: sets `status: withdrawn`, logs withdrawal activity event, records exit reason in learnings

routes.whatTheyPasted: A code/projects folder path or repo URL ("scan my projects", "see what I've built")
A mailbox sync request (Apple Mail / Gmail / Outlook)
An in-platform message sync request (LinkedIn / Wellfound DMs)
A company name / "tell me about X" / a company homepage URL
A wishlist of employers to target / "find companies like X to add"
routes.capturesInto: tracked-company source config through `careerrat companies` (SQLite in DB workspaces, legacy `config/sourced-scan.json` otherwise) (confirm-first)

routes.whatTheyPasted: "is X a safe bet" / company risk, layoffs, financial health, morale — scoped to the role
A standalone fact / preference / constraint (comp, location, an exclusion)
Anything else with no obvious owner (a note, a stray link, a screenshot)
routes.capturesInto: `workspace/intake/<slug>-<date>.md`, linked to the nearest application or company
